notes.title: Merry Christmas and Free Update! EX-stage - Let the eyes fly!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/2b7ecc72aa71c5c065906b83d8ca2c24cadb324c.jpg[/img]

Orin is exhausted, she doesn't want to work for Sanae any more. Only she wants is to spend a relaxing Christmas.
All things went so well and Christmas is coming, but she cannot feel a little bit happy.
Satori opened her third eye and said: That's what we call depression.
Depression? Orin doesn't understand the word, but that sounds terrible.

Satori reached out her hand.

[h3]"Then, find the happiness back, shall we?"[/h3]

Let's find our happiness back with Satori (illust: 藤Choco) this Christmas!

Update v.1.3.0
New Ex-stage - Let the eyes fly!
New Map - Old Hell Market
New Character - Satori

Merry Christmas! 

Team L.U.R.Id Glow
Dec. 24th , 2023

notes.title: Touhou Ibunseki: Re v.1.0.0 about to release
notes.content:
Dear Ibunseki Players,

We’re very glad to inform everyone that Ibunseki will reach its complete form in the next update!

[h3][Contents][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Add OP, ED and an ending story.
[*] After the release of the v1.0.0, we'll complete the JP voice for other characters!
[*] After the release of the v1.0.0, we’ll keep update the content including 4 new collaboration characters: [/olist][list]

[*] Wakasagihime by Socha
[*] Komeiji Satori by Fuzichoco
[*] Tsukumo Benben by Kieta. [/list]Each character will be updated with a special mission and map!


[h3][OST Release][/h3]
The OST will release along with the v1.0.0 game - 40 pieces of music (by v.1.0.0) including OP, ED and Interlude Song. A 8-bit style main title BGM will be added as the bonus track! The BGMs for the collab characters will be updated for free once the contents are available!

The price in US will change to 18.99 USD as the release of v.1.0.0. Other regions will also change, please visit the shop page by then or mail the dev to ask for detail.

Thank you again for liking our game! We hope to see you in the v.1.0.0 soon!

notes.title: Update v0.9.0 - Online mode stabilized, Chapter 7 updated
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/2b58568cb4f3117d547fa475cd1874d66cd032ba.jpg[/img]
[b]Caution: The saved game of older versions CANNOT be loaded this version. Please finish the game before you update, or you can just delete the saved game files. 
Or you can just overwrite the old save files with the new ones.
A game crash is highly likely to happen if you persist on loading old saving files. Deleting the saved games will not affect the unlocking process of the game (mission and characters).[/b]

[h3]HOW TO DELETE OLD SAVED FILES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/5d608e1dcf97bbd41ac1bcc969928681a57ca6fd.jpg[/img]
Path: [USERNAME]/Appdata/Local/THAD_Re_v1_0_0
Delete saved games: All files in [game_save] folder.
Delete online saved games (BETA version only): All files in [multiplayer_save] folder. 

Make sure you delete the files while the game is running, or Steam Cloud will auto recover the files.

[h2]------Now the main course------[/h2]

Dear Ibunseki Players,

A long time has passed and we're back to update the game again!

[h2]ONLINE MATCH[/h2]
This time, we've got a major change in the online game!
The stability of online mode has been largely improved - after a month's testing and debugging, there is little chance that of game crash during the online mode!
We've also adjusted the character's skill to make the game more balanced~ Check out what is changed for your favourite characters~
Here's how to get and play the online version.
[h3][HOW TO GET]  [/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1138100/announcements/detail/2372781945492685635
[h3][HOW TO PLAY][/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1138100/announcements/detail/2372781945494101320
[h3][S/L in ONLINE MODE][/h3]
Online mode is now with Save/Load feature, you can stop the game anytime you want, and continue the game later.
[b][USAGE][/b]
1.The autosave feature is enabled for online match, the saving files are stored on the host machine.
2.To restore the game, the host should first load the game, then all other clients connect to the host.
3.All the players should use exactly the same [Name] of the saved game if you want to join.
4.If not all the players are available, you can choose a COM to replace this player.
[h2]CHAPTER 7[/h2]
This update also contains Chapter 7 - "At Sixes & Sevens". Story, maps and new character Fujiwara no Mokou & Houraisan Kaguya!
We've also added summary interface after the finishing of free mode.
2 new functional road blocks have been added - Remi/Flan's Blood Donation Place. Please have a look at them in the Map Editor!

[h3]And now you can take a screenshot with F12 key[/h3]
The image will be stored in [GAMEPATH]\Screens

Thank you and so sorry for keeping you waiting so long, we'll do our best to update the game!

Merry Christmas!

Team L.U.R.Id Glow
Dec. 25th 2020

notes.title: Annual Anniversary for Ibunseki ~ Multiple Big News Released!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/7c40fe7eac8af32394ae6f2ab3aea8f9844a83f8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/d1245969665a52eb3287031fdef4a0316d25fb1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/7997608fc34ec9adf4a77775319d74675c2917d0.jpg[/img]

Dear Ibunseki Players：

Time flies and it's been a year since Ibunseki firstly released as early access version. And to celebrate her one year old birthday, we will launch a 3-day promotion from Nov. 11th to Nov. 14th. and it will be the lowest price ever! Grab this chance if you want to play it or to invite your friend to play with you~

So, main course, the big show! We're here to announce several big news about Ibunseki~

[h3]1. Special Guest Illustrator x Extra Missions! Along with the new characters![/h3]

As we promised, to thank for you guys for the support, we invited three illustrators that is well known in Touhou community, and asked them to help making 3 Extra stages and the related characters!

Here they come ---
Little Patchy --- Tamano Kedama
Wakasagihime --- Socha
Komeiji Satori --- Fuzichoco

Every extra stage is specially designed and you need different strategy to win the game~ Also, we have added a different story to each stage!
Please look forward for their performance~
BTW, another mystery sponsor Mr. Y helps adding another extra stage. Let's just keep it as a secret for now, and wait for the moment of its disclosure~

[h3]2. Original Soundtrack of Ibuseki will be published after the game ends its EA version![/h3]
This DLC will contain 40+ originally composed music from Ibunseki, you can't miss it~

[h3]3. New functional road blocks (well, something like the "event block"/"get card block") will be added![/h3]
We'll add unique road blocks according to the maps. This will bring different gaming experiences for you in each map. Hope you'll enjoy this~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/cb15c374eae7e06f01338c0198dd2669e81a00bc.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/5604c820233bdc9ef685a5f2eec5c78a73c7e81b.png[/img]

[h3]Lastly, the EA stage of Ibunseki will soon be ended and the v1.0 is coming![/h3]
Compared to the current game, here are the contents to be added in version 1.0:

4 more story stages and related maps.
We'll also add some ex-stages.
Related characters will join the game~

Thanks again for all your support and criticize this year~
We'll keep working and please, please follow us in the upcoming next year~

Sincerely,
Team L.U.R.Id Glow
Nov. 10th, 2020

notes.title: An Update after April Fool's Day
notes.content:
Dear Ibunseki Players

I don't know if you have believed in the news we published on April Fool's Day.

Welp, actually the man who write the news is so bad at lying, except for "the illustrator will be replaced" item. All the other news are true.

Yes, we're now under developing of online versus mode.
Yes, 粗茶 and 玉之けだま will join us in the develop of the game, along with another one.
And yes, you can play Ludo in Ibunseki style later in the updates.

So why is "illustrator being fired" stuff a fake news? Welp, he is the BOSS of the dev you know :D:D:D

Team L.U.R.Id Glow is a four-man group that making Ibunseki after their daily work is done. So it will take longer to develop the game. We planned for bi-weekly updates, but, well, things changed more often than you can expect. But we will never abandon the project as there are many players watching and waiting for its accomplishment. It will, probably, take even longer time if we begin making the online mode. But just believe us, we will make it to the end :D



Oh, BTW we made a small update includes:

[olist]
[*] Fix display errors of dice in the Yaokai Battle;
[*] Fix the manga display error;
[*] Optimize AI and increasing game speed.
[/olist]


Thanks for all you guys for the support!

Sincerely,
Team L.U.R.Id Glow

Apr. 3rd, 2020

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/23bf87bb54da0189122e4a40e3fed979123e6848.png[/img]
[h3]- In New Story Chapter [/h3]
The new story chapter "4 miles down under" has a bug that [u][b]if you achieve the goal of destroying Sanae's Research Stations and Power Plants, clicking on the player detailed info button will cause game crash[/b][/u]. We've fixed the bug in the update. We're sorry about the trouble.

[h3]- Old Save/Load Files[/h3]
The new version is [b]NOT[/b] fully compatible with the the S/L files of the older version due to technical reasons.

[h3]- Unlock Feature[/h3]
The versions from now on are with the unlock feature that most all characters will be locked until the relevant chapters are accomplished. 
We recommend the new players of Ibunseki to start the game from the very beginning. 
For other players have played all the chapters before, you can[u][b] press U at the main menu[/b][/u] to unlock all the chapters and characters except Sanae and Orin.

notes.title: Bi-week Update 2019.11.22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36049944/7115285b5e5d8d6f598c4540f566a70e879c28da.png[/img]

===Update Content===

[b]1.	Add story mode: Prologue and Chapter 1
2.	New map: Komakan Outskirt
3.	New Chara: Izayoi Sakuya
4.	5 New events and 4 new skill cards
5.	Improved AI
6.	Display optimization:[/b]
1)	Accelerate animation, cancelled uneccesary discriptions.
2)	Icons will be displayed above the areas affected by market and power plant.
3)	Crystal cooldown will be displayed above the miner.
[b]7.	Bug Fix:[/b]
1)	Blue crystals will not be disappeared by touching it with another one in your hand.
2)	SP and crystal point will not go below 0.
3)	Fixed the bug that cannot reverse the "Enhance" item to 0 in the Level Editor.
[b]8.	Misc.:[/b]
1)	Bomb will not be triggered upon discharging by hospital or being free from jail.
2)	Maximum number of Freeplay maps increased to 50.
3)	Maximum gametime of Freeplay limited to 10 months.
4)	The crystals will start regenerating after being dug out for easier obtaining the crystals.
5)	Marisa's skill CD extended from 7 to 10.
6)	The interest of bank is no longer relevant to the price index.
7)	Suwako can only capture the Hotel after checking out.
8)	Shield can protect structures from being captured.
9)	BGM will change during the game.
10)	SP regeneration increased to 5. Extra 10 SP will be obtained per time when in hospital or hotel.

Notice: Old in-game saving files might be incompatible with the newest version in the future updates, you’ll be informed if this happens. The process of story mode will not be affected.
